text: The color utility waits for stored folder properties, tracks windows, and observes server-color-changed while at least one window is registered. Each update sets or removes server-key color properties on documentElement.style. The account manager stores colors by root-folder URI; absent custom colors fall back through CSS. Account enumeration is shared per update, while color lookup remains per window/account and its optimization is explicitly deferred. This is a scoped component contract, not a preferred module pattern or measured performance claim.
title: Account color updates set root CSS properties in registered windows
